featured_reviews.name: Arpit Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
We order a butterfly cake which was supposed to be weighing 500gm however the actual weight was 400gm only that too including the paper board which could be around 30-50gms. This is how they cheat their customers. Upon complaining to the shop owner they said do whatever you want, we have been doing this since long time and nothing has happened to us.
Clearly avoid such places who knows nothing but to cheat.

featured_reviews.name: Dev Patel
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very disappointing experience at Sweet Country Cake Shop. From the moment I walked in, the service felt unprofessional and inattentive. The staff seemed uninterested in helping customers and lacked basic courtesy. I had to wait quite a long time just to place my order, even though the shop wasn’t particularly busy.

The quality of the cake itself was far below expectations. The design looked rushed and nothing like what was promised. The cake was overly sweet to the point of being unpleasant, and the texture was dry instead of soft and fresh. It honestly felt like it had been sitting out for too long before being served.

Hygiene was another concern. The display area didn’t look clean, and I noticed crumbs and smudges on the counter, which made me question the overall cleanliness of the kitchen as well.

Considering the price they charge, the experience and product quality do not justify the cost at all. There are definitely much better bakeries out there offering fresher, tastier cakes with far better service.

Overall, I would not recommend Sweet Country Cake Shop. It was a waste of money and time, and I won’t be returning.

featured_reviews.review_text: I ordered customised K Pop theme cake for my 5 year daughter's birthday, cake was delivered in time, it was super delicious and it was not too creamy perfect texture, 2nd cake was chocolate fantasy cake it was also too delicious, Thank you to all whole team for execution as per my need and requirements😍

featured_reviews.name: Parthavi Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text: Visited Sweet County for their 'Have a Brownie Break' campaign and I’m so impressed! I tried the Walnut and Hazelnut brownies—they were incredibly fresh and fudgy. At just Rs. 49, it’s an absolute steal. I also loved their Makar Sankranti themed Kite Bento cakes; they are so creative and perfect for the festival. Great service and delicious treats!

featured_reviews.name: Shubh Jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
We've been ordering cakes from them for almost every occasion at our home be it birthday's or anniversaries. The taste has been good so far until recently where we had issues with our order and that kind of ruined the customer experience for us.
We purchased their KitKat cake for a birthday celebration and when we cut it during the celebration, we felt a very odd taste.. it didn't feel like it was a fresh cake as they claimed it to be. The next morning, the first thing we did was called them and informed them about this and we were told to get the cake to them and they'll see what can be done, we did so. Upon reaching, they checked the cake and told us that since half of the cake was consumed they couldn't refund but would replace it with a PASTRY (we paid ₹500 for it, but they wanted to give us a PASTRY as a compensation), mind you, the cake wasn't consumed, we had to throw half of it when we distributed it during the celebration due to the odd taste and risk of causing any health complications. They initially denied and told they couldn't do anything about it and upon explaining them about how often we buy from them and how unfair it would be to compensate with a pastry for a cake, they agreed to give us a fresh cake.
An odd experience but they did agree to give us a fresh cake. Hope they do something about this experience I've had so no one else has to face it.

featured_reviews.name: Darshan Dalal
featured_reviews.review_text: It's a great place to get cakes and have pastries. We ordered the classic Blueberry Cheesecake and Death by Chocolate pastries. Both were quite good. Also, the ambience is nice. Overall, a good place for a dessert date.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently purchased Aflatoon from Suleman Usman Mithaiwala, and the taste is absolutely authentic and delicious. It is definitely a must-try for anyone visiting Mumbai!
However, I have a small suggestion regarding the packaging for outstation customers. Currently, it is provided in paper boxes. When transporting it over long distances (like to Kerala), the ghee tends to soak through the paper, making the sweets dry by the time they reach. It would be great if you could offer leak-proof or vacuum-sealed packaging options for those traveling far.
Overall, amazing quality and highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Kainaaz Bokdawalla
featured_reviews.review_text:
I bought a wedge of Almond Orange Cake from Gatoh's Individual Serve Menu. It was theobromic! Nutty, sweet, sticky withba hint of tanginess. It's a cake i would reorder in a jiffy. It was my kinda cake.

We picked 1 Eclair Classique. Unfortunately, this one missed the mark quite badly. It was a gpod choux, filled with Vanilla-Mascarpone, glazed with Chocolate and yet... it was sickenly salty. Why? I have no clue. I comprehend a touch of salt to enhance the sweet but sooo salty... Big No!  I cannot give Gatoh 5 stars because of this issue. As always.. #SeedhiBaatNoBakwaas writeup.

We also bought a box of 6 Original Madeleine (Brown Butter & Lemon) These were one of the best Mads ive ever had.. and i, truly, have had excellent Mads in Pune, from a Micro Patisserie, so i know exactly what im eating when i bite into excellent Mad. Pillow-y, buttery, tangy.. everything a perfect Mad should be!! Btw, reordered the Mads. Im greedily carrying them to Pune. 😄 I clicked a lovely video of the Mads but i think Google does not allow videos you'll have to catch it on my Insta story @kenzyskitchenkorner Go check it out!!

Gatoh.. for the Almond Orange Cake and the stellar Mads, you truly have my 🫶🏻

featured_reviews.review_text:

This cut out caught my attention and thought to give it a try. I was amazed to see all Bengali delicacies. I tried vegetable chop that was much bigger in size and tasty and available only for Rs 15/-. I also tried roshogulla, Kamala bhog, rasmalai, sitabhog, mihi daana, kochuri with aloo tarkari and believe me all the dishes had authentic taste and were reasonably priced. It's a must visit for Bengali food lovers.
They also told that they have their main course restaurant also in other lane. Looking forward to visit it once.

featured_reviews.review_text: I worked with Nicole to create personalized mithai boxes for my wedding announcement, and the entire experience was exceptional. She made this special part of my wedding celebrations feel seamless and memorable. Thank you and much love to Bombay Sweet Shop and Nicole!!

featured_reviews.review_text: Love your bark butterscotch but had a bad  experience when my cousin ordered it for me via zomato. Firstly the bill was 1768inr and zomato charged me 1828inr. The delivery person was rude because he did not have change and it took me sometime to get change. I would sincerely suggest not to buy via zomato.

featured_reviews.name: Suhasini Sudan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Love their ambience, their decorations, and their trial sweet and savoury snacks. Love their unique twist on fusion Indo-western desserts and snacks. Their Avo Papdi chaat is delicious and so are their Gulab Jamun churros, their Rasgulla Tiramisu and their special strawberry menu. Their thick hot chocolate with the special cookie is also a personal favourite. I also love their chocolate barks, especially the strawberry chocolate one.

Has become such a stable, me and my friends go there practically every week. Amazing for a treat.

featured_reviews.name: Akarsh Kavuttan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Finally had the opportunity to visit the famous Bombay Sweet Shop!

Although I couldn’t have much as I had already ordered a bunch of sweets earlier on the occasion of Women’s Day!

Nevertheless the vibe was fantastic! The interiors were also fantastic!

featured_reviews.name: Priya pokhare
featured_reviews.review_text: Mithais are more than just good packaging and presentation. People may be all impressed with BSS but honestly I was a bit underwhelmed. I have gifted friends and family with their items . But they are overdoing the fusion stuff , which I guess is the point but they are losing their vision. I also think they do not use good quality chocolate for their brittle and fudge. The fudge tastes flat and nothing of chocolate. The only decent thing maybe the chocolate butter cookies . I would like to like them but they need to make it make sense for the price I pay .

featured_reviews.name: Anasuya Roshan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had these delivered in Mumbai and brought over to Malaysia within 24hrs. They lasted the entire journey intact and lip smacking good!

I strongly recommend the Cheat Box, Assorted Mithai Box and Kalakand (any flavour of the Kalakand if you can get your hands on some). Bite-sized portions, provided you exercise control, which is impossible I'd say. Their namkeens are addictive, those should come with warning labels. All edibles are have allergens labelled on their packaging; it simplifies matters for those who have restrictive diets.

None of the sweets are overly sweet despite being 'sweets'. I'm not sure how to explain the irony of that sentence, but those who have an indulgent sweet tooth AND a hawk's eye on their calorie intake, you know what I mean.

Always a good experience shopping from you!

featured_reviews.name: Sassinator
featured_reviews.review_text: BSS is extraordinary!! We were introduced to the store thru an equally amazing 5 Senses Tour. We HAD to go back!! The service and the sweets were OFF THE CHARTS!! We even brought our Uber driver in to treat him to their delicious ice cream!!

featured_reviews.name: Amruta S
featured_reviews.review_text: Don’t buy from them online! I placed an online order in time for Diwali. The order was well Packaged but had an important missing item - the kaju katli burfi. Their customer service does not exist! Neither on WhatsApp, email or phone. Best to go to the store and get what you pay for instead of paying for missed items and chasing them with no result.
